traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are satisfied: - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags (tested explicitly). - The parser terminates annotation values at JSDoc tag boundaries and only continues multi-line values on non-@tag lines. - Any non-traceability JSDoc tag is treated as a boundary. - The original concatenation bug (`REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data`) is covered by a dedicated test and no longer occurs. - Documentation for the valid-annotation-format rule has been updated with a dedicated JSDoc coexistence section and examples referencing this story. - All relevant tests pass in the full test suite, and earlier stories’ behavior remains intact.
Based on concrete code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented.
